subject.title: Rename i18n locale codes from region-based (zh-CN/zh-TW) to script-based (zh-Hans/zh-Hant)

question: Should OpenClaw make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` the canonical Chinese locale IDs across Control UI, CLI wizard, docs, generated i18n artifacts, and saved browser preferences?
rationale: The rename is technically reasonable, but it changes shipped public IDs, documented setup inputs, generated artifact names, and persisted browser preferences, so automation should not choose the alias and migration policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve coordinated script-code migration
options.body: Make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` canonical and require one migration PR that updates runtime, docs, generated artifacts, tests, and old-value handling together.

options.title: Keep region-code public IDs
options.body: Leave `zh-CN` and `zh-TW` as public runtime and CLI IDs while accepting script-form inputs only as aliases that resolve to the existing IDs.

options.title: Split docs metadata from runtime IDs
options.body: Limit script-based naming to docs or publishing metadata while keeping runtime and CLI locale IDs unchanged.

recommendation.title: Approve coordinated script-code migration
recommendation.body: Make `zh-Hans` and `zh-Hant` canonical and require one migration PR that updates runtime, docs, generated artifacts, tests, and old-value handling together.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent Koc has the strongest current-history connection to the Control UI i18n registry and generator surfaces that would carry the coordinated migration.
